briefdescription.para: determines the ordering of id numbers

detaileddescription.para: Certain uses of the CFG rely on a specific numbering scheme for the nodes of the CFG. The nodes can either be numbered in breadth-first-search order rooted at the entry node, and following edges forward, or in breadth-first-search order rooted at the exit node and following edges backward.
